call_thesis.source_content:
Pump Pulls ($PP) is a launchpad on Solana that turns memecoin creator fees into collectible card packs.

Anyone can launch a coin and tie it to a card gacha, similar to a Pokemon or One Piece pack machine.

The idea is simple: the trading fees a coin earns are used to open pack pulls.

The graded cards that come out of those packs go straight to the wallets of the coin's holders.

The platform runs on 's Packs API, with packs provided by Collector Crypt. There is also a live opening page and a feed of the latest pulls.

The motto is Hold. Earn. Collect.

Creators get a fresh hook for their community, and card collectors get a new way to enter the memecoin space.

Trading fees become something you can actually open, collect and show off.

translation_content.en:
Pump Pulls ($PP) is a launchpad on Solana that turns memecoin creator fees into collectible card packs.

Anyone can launch a coin and tie it to a card gacha, similar to a Pokemon or One Piece pack machine.

The idea is simple: the trading fees a coin earns are used to open pack pulls.

The graded cards that come out of those packs go straight to the wallets of the coin's holders.

The platform runs on 's Packs API, with packs provided by Collector Crypt. There is also a live opening page and a feed of the latest pulls.

The motto is Hold. Earn. Collect.

Creators get a fresh hook for their community, and card collectors get a new way to enter the memecoin space.

Trading fees become something you can actually open, collect and show off.
translation_content.zh_hans:
Pump Pulls ($PP) 是 Solana 上的一个发射平台，它将 meme 币创建者费用转化为可收藏的卡牌包。

任何人都可以发行代币并将其绑定到卡牌扭蛋机，类似于宝可梦或海贼王卡包机。

这个想法很简单：代币赚取的交易费用用于开卡包。

从这些卡包中开出的评级卡直接进入代币持有者的钱包。

该平台运行在 's Packs API 上，卡包由 Collector Crypt 提供。此外还有实时开卡页面和最新开卡动态。

座右铭是：持仓、赚取、收藏。

创作者为他们的社区获得了一个新奇的噱头，而卡牌收藏家则获得了一种进入 meme 币领域的新方式。

交易费用变成了一种你可以真正开箱、收藏和炫耀的东西。
